message.content: {"attacks":[{"source":"arg3","target":"arg1","rationale":"The possibility of judicial error challenges the claim that the death penalty is necessary in extreme cases."},{"source":"arg4","target":"arg3","rationale":"Advances in DNA analysis are presented as reducing the risk of the judicial errors raised by the opponents."},{"source":"arg6","target":"arg1","rationale":"The irreversibility of the death penalty and the fatal consequences of error undermine its claimed necessity."},{"source":"arg7","target":"arg1","rationale":"The higher cost of appeals and procedures weakens the claim that the death penalty is necessary."}]}
